component.name: Addict

description.p: Addict is a hotkey translator for readers of English, Spanish and Catalan. Select or copy a word or a sentence anywhere, press the shortcut, and a small window shows the dictionary article of the word: its senses, synonyms, transcriptions with recordings, and its Russian translations.

ul.li: A clipboard shortcut reads the selected text, or the clipboard when nothing is selected, the same way in every application
Offline dictionary lookup in English, Spanish and Catalan, by the word as written and by its dictionary forms
Russian translations from the dictionaries and, online with a DeepL API key, of the clicked word in the context of its sentence and of the sentence itself
A separate screenshot shortcut opens a region picker to read text in an image or a video with Tesseract OCR; assign its key in Settings
Normal launches show the main window, with Settings available directly; use --background for a silent login launch
A Russian word is looked up the other way: its translations into the reading language
